sources.title: nsfw-flux-dev: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview nsfw-flux-dev is a text-to-image generation model maintained by aisha-ai-official that generates images up to 4096×4096 pixels from natural language prompts. This model is built on the FLUX.1-dev architecture from Black Forest Labs and operates on Replicate's infrastructure. The critical distinction: this is a variant explicitly configured to handle adult content generation without ...

sources.title: Uncensored Local Image Generation: FLUX, SDXL, Z-Image
sources.snippet: Is FLUX uncensored? At runtime, yes — no filter ships in FLUX.1 dev or SDXL weights. Plus Z-Image, Qwen-Image and Chroma: per-model filter behavior, VRAM and setup.
